email.body1:
Natalie, saw Minitab shipped enhanced AI features and climbed to #17 on G2's 2026 analytics list.

Momentum like that usually surfaces more in-market accounts than a regional team can cover by hand, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Minitab off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Natalie, quick follow-up for Minitab.

New AI features and rising recognition create a window where demand outpaces rep capacity in a region. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to convert that interest, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Minitab needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Natalie, last bit of proof for Minitab.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Minitab's reply rate likely compares to other analytics software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Natalie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Timing matters most after a product and awards push, and I know covering a region through it is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an analytics software motion? I will tailor it to Minitab either way.
